purpose: Single-block scalar diagnosis against same-run main only, not a formal Rust comparison, statistical result, acceptance, or improvement versus any prior candidate.
scope_note: Frozen693 contains plan fragments and input revision; current a6 array work is absent.

controller.reported_tool_exit_origin: Root observation supplied via --controller-exit; not independently encoded by runner.

legacy_memory_scope.observed_scope: root-only in every archived sample; no child RSS observed. Sampler swallows unavailable /proc/<pid>/task/<pid>/children. Not process-tree or total build memory, and no memory advantage claim.

fixture_reference.comparison_scope: Source fixture identity only; its timing data is neither extracted nor compared.

limitations: One pair per measured case, one block; OS page cache not flushed. No comparison against prior candidate timings.
Recorded ELF/LLVM pair hashes and actual native results are checked; overwritten historical artifact files are not reconstructed.
Default quotas and current independent Verify remain part of the source pipeline; narrow counters do not imply all work is item-local.
Raw durability requires a separate remote archive receipt.
